q: What is the carbon footprint of a kirana store?
title: Kirana store: carbon footprint
short: For most kirana stores it is the electricity bill: fridges, freezers, lights and fans, at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Add an inverter's losses or a small genset if you have one. Goods you sell carry their own footprint, which sits in Scope 3 and is rarely asked of a small shop.

ul: Units on the monthly electricity bill.
Diesel or petrol for a genset or delivery bike.
Refrigerant top-ups for an old fridge.

p: A newer star-rated fridge and LED lights cut the bill and the carbon together.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
